units.source_text: 搬运大网篮的人围着老头，突然爆发出一阵疯狂的大笑。

en.t: The people carrying the large net basket gathered around the old man and suddenly burst into wild laughter.

units.source_text: 男人像被人使劲勒住似的站着一动不动。

en.t: The man stood motionless, as if someone had tightened a grip around him with all their strength.

units.source_text: 他开始慢慢地、一丝不苟地理解起来。

en.t: He began to understand, slowly and with meticulous care.

units.source_text: 他开始理解正在理解的自己。

en.t: He began to understand himself in the very act of understanding.

units.source_text: 仔细想来，这项提案也并非那么令人惊奇。

en.t: On careful thought, the proposal was not really so surprising after all.
